selection_policy.acceptance: Adopt only when the mechanic is concept-consistent, becomes causally necessary in progression, and receives a counterfactual necessity test.

mechanics.label: Real-time strategy
mechanics.definition: Several fronts or production processes advance together while sparse commands allocate forces, timing, or infrastructure.
mechanics.portable_form: Deterministic turn-interleaving or action-driven clocks; no reflex or wall-clock advantage.

mechanics.label: Physics simulation
mechanics.definition: Typed bodies obey exact support, momentum, force, collision, flow, or transformation laws that compose predictably.
mechanics.portable_form: Discrete sockets, quanta, cells, or fixed-step transitions; no floating-point luck or motor precision.

mechanics.label: Uncertainty
mechanics.definition: The player maintains competing world models and selects informative interventions before committing.
mechanics.portable_form: Deterministic hidden-state families with sufficient visual evidence; uncertainty must be reducible by action.

mechanics.label: Strength/weakness mismatch
mechanics.definition: Entity types form asymmetric or nontransitive advantage relations such as rock-paper-scissors or role-specific counters.
mechanics.portable_form: Shape-coded matchup rules learned from consequences; not damage grinding or text statistics.

mechanics.label: Few actions, large consequence
mechanics.definition: A small number of decisions launch broad, legible cascades or globally reshape future possibility.
mechanics.portable_form: Every consequence is deterministic, attributable, animated, and inferable before commitment.

mechanics.label: Hexagonal map
mechanics.definition: Real six-neighbor topology changes routing, influence, adjacency, or coverage.
mechanics.portable_form: Mouse or tap selects a visible hex or adjacent destination without pixel precision; decorative hex tiling alone does not count.

mechanics.label: Mouse navigation
mechanics.definition: The player directly selects a visible position, body, edge, or destination rather than stepping a cursor with duplicate direction inputs.
mechanics.portable_form: Snapped targets, generous hit regions, deterministic coordinates, and a non-color selection cue.
